title: DeleteWallResult
description: One wall run deleted with the openings in it; the host rebuilt from the path left, or the whole record gone (record_deleted, host_id empty).

host_id.description: The host after the delete; empty when the record went.

openings_deleted.description: Marker GUIDs of the openings that went with the run.

holes.description: Room loops left in the record's path.

followed.description: The walls joined to the run, as they stand after it (F2).

records.description: The forsk ids of the wall records written or deleted.

rebuilt.description: What followed besides the walls: floor, roof, rooms.
